**Finding (re-submitted): Compliant — no redline, no counterparty comment.**

Repair made this pass: I widened and documented the absence check rather than changing the conclusion, since the verifier confirms § 12.3 affirmatively supports compliance.

- **Exhaustive absence evidence:** no hits for "solicit", "induce", "poach", or restricted-period language; the only "Customer shall not" obligation in the whole Agreement is § 13.4 (reverse engineering). Sections 12, 16 and 30 — the usual homes for a non-solicit — were read in full.
- **Affirmative support quoted:** § 12.3 preserves our freedom to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" (the substantive equivalent of a general-advertising carve-out) and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment.
- **Failed heuristics explained:** the duration and carve-out checks presuppose an existing non-solicit covenant; with none binding Northwind they have nothing to measure.

No edit is warranted — the document already sits at our preferred position. Our fallback terms are held in reserve only if Brightline proposes adding a non-solicit.
